verdict.rationale: Granola documents a self-serve CSV export of historical data (Settings > Profile > Generate CSV) that includes note titles, summaries, transcripts and basic details. The docs explicitly frame it as suitable for backups, migration and GDPR data portability, and the REST API separately offers programmatic access to notes, transcripts and AI summaries. Missing for 10: no evidence the export covers all data (captured screenshots, templates, recipes, chat history, folders), CSV is the only file format (no Markdown/JSON bulk export), no documented account-deletion or offboarding path, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
